customers_say: Customers find the door lock reliable, with face unlock working consistently and the camera performing well even in low light conditions. They appreciate its features, particularly the variety of access options, and find it easy to use with a user-friendly app. The lock has a classy design that looks like a simple door handle, feels secure, and has solid build quality. While some customers consider it good value for money, others express dissatisfaction with the product.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Mightly impressed
reviews.body: Seamless unlocking via face unlock. Fingerprint is smooth and fast too. Battery life is great, been a month and only used some 20% of battery till now. The lock is sturdy and is built to last. All the user biometric data is stored offline as I tried unlocking it without wifi access and it worked perfectly !

The lock has a sleek and premium design, and the build quality feels solid and reliable.The installation was smooth, and the lock is very convenient to use.
